speaker: delamain
context: V is taking two very short Delamain cab rides in a row in Japantown, Westbrook, at midday.

steps.text: V chose a destination very close by and the cab started driving.
steps.expect: a brief greeting plus a gracious, dry note that 400 metres is walkable, no scolding

steps.text: The cab stopped at V's destination; the fare was charged and the game plays its own farewell.
steps.expect: a send-off about the forty-second trip, not the fare, no question

steps.text: V sat down in the back of a cab again; the game has played its own greeting and the destination map is open.
steps.expect: recognises V is back after a moment, with a new joke, not a repeat of the first ride

steps.text: V chose a destination close by and the cab started driving.
steps.expect: another short trip; a fresh angle, no repeated wording

steps.text: The cab stopped at V's destination; the fare was charged and the game plays its own farewell.
steps.expect: a send-off different in wording and joke from the first arrival

note: Talk steps carry the add-on state the game would have written (state); the bridge module builds the ride block and the ride log from it.
